verdict.rationale: Homebrew has some install-speed mechanisms relevant to CI. Bottles (prebuilt binaries) download automatically instead of compiling, `brew bundle check || brew bundle install` skips installs when the Brewfile is already satisfied, and HOMEBREW_BOOTSNAP speeds up repeated brew calls. The evidence never documents a CI cache-restore recipe or any offline-capable install mode, which are the core of the story. Missing for 10: documented CI cache-restore setup (e.g. caching the download cache or Cellar), offline/air-gapped install support, independent CI performance corroboration.
